div.div: مُسْحِنٌ A horse goodly in condition; as in the saying, جَآءَ الفَرَسُ مُسْحِنًا [The horse came goodly in condition]: fem, with ة: (L, K:) you say فَرَسٌ مُسْحِنَةٌ, (L,) or ↓ مُسَحَّنَةٌ , (S, [so in my copies,]) a mare goodly in condition and in aspect, (L,) or goodly in aspect. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
